name: validator
description: Critical appraisal with the right instrument, every slot answered, and the domain verdicts computed from the answers instead of asserted. Routes a study design to its instrument — RoB 2 for randomised trials (effect of assignment or of adhering), ROBINS-I for non-randomised interventions (2016 numbering), ROBINS-E for exposures, QUADAS-2 for diagnostic accuracy, QUIPS for prognostic factors (the 31 published prompting items), PROBAST+AI and TRIPOD+AI for prediction models, AMSTAR 2 and ROBIS for systematic reviews, the Newcastle-Ottawa stars where a journal insists, JBI for case reports, case series, cross-sectional, prevalence and qualitative designs, and GRADE for the certainty of a body of evidence per outcome. Prints the full slot list, verifies that none was left blank and that every answer is one the item offers, and applies each tool's published rating algorithm where one exists — a domain with an unanswered question is INCOMPLETE, never LOW, and GRADE gives no certainty while publication bias is undecided. Deterministic and offline; item lists, per-instrument answer vocabularies and the 1.x-to-2.0 id migration are parsed from the reference files so the script and the reference cannot drift apart.
